ig_caption:
Fri, Nov 13: 1,729 deer reported statewide (1,342 antlered, 387 antlerless). Season total: 100,102.

Friday's 1,729 new reports were the first daily increase after five straight declines from the 3,685 peak on Nov 8. Statewide highs of 39 degrees may have helped archery hunters get out ahead of Sunday's firearm opener.
